summary: Verified CSP duplicate-removal fix for homepage access tracking. inicio.html (file and served /) has exactly ONE CSP meta tag containing connect-src 'self'. Browser visit to / fired POST /api/track/access -> 200, no CSP violation for the fetch; new accesses docs with page='/' inserted in ibge_2026_db (count 1 -> 3). Admin /donaspainel (donas) dashboard shows kpi-acessos=3, funnel 'Acessos ao site'=3, live activity lists 'Novo acesso desktop'. Visiting admin panel did not increment accesses. Dedup (same visitor_id within 30min) and admin-path skip verified via pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: Homepage CSP script-src 'unsafe-inline' data: blocks Cloudflare-injected scripts (cloudflareinsights beacon, /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform). Harmless for tracking; if a Cloudflare bot challenge is ever on, add those origins.
Homepage never reaches networkidle (some connection stays open). This isn't a bug, but use wait_until='load' in automation.
seed_data_creation: Browser visits added 2 real accesses docs (page='/') plus their access events, now shown in the dashboard. The pytest access doc (visitor_id TEST_v_*) and its event were deleted by id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DB ibge_2026_db; collections accesses/events/admins. track/access dedups by visitor_id (30min), so clear localStorage for a new access. Run pytest without -p no:xdist (pytest.ini uses -n).
